scope: File moves, import rewrites, portable package resources and metadata only; no CLI or numerical changes
runtime_dependencies: Declare existing runtime dependencies; exclude torch, PyG and scatter

scorer_loader.near_zero_policy: Absolute tolerance only, including near zero; saved nulls and categorical fields exact
scorer_loader.justification: User-required packaging equivalence; same device, inputs, checkpoint, scorer and RNG order
scorer_loader.metrics: All persisted score JSON fields, including physical balance; each origin compared independently

installation.isolated_without_torch: ImportError with README install matrix pointer

static.scientific_function_AST: Unchanged apart from import and resource/provenance paths

stop_conditions: Any scientific equivalence failure stops the gate
No merge or tag before all gates pass
No training, automatic resubmission or changes to released artifacts
job.retry_policy: Only packaging/test infrastructure corrections or an interrupted gate, within the cumulative cap; never change numerical thresholds
